description: This file defines an abstract class 'PojoCodeProducer' responsible for generating Java and native POJO code. It contains logic for processing enum dependencies within POJO generation context, including methods to gather enums that need to be generated.

classes.name: PojoCodeProducer
classes.description: Abstract class for generating Java and native POJO code, managing dependencies on enums during generation.

methods.name: getEnumsToGenerate
methods.description: Collects and returns a list of EnumDefWrapper objects representing enums that need to be generated, filtered based on section masks and prior generation status.
